question: How do devotees reach Vishnu's abode and what lies beyond it?
premises: Devotees of Vishnu reach his abode through meditation, worship, and recitation.
Beyond the world of Vishnu lies another world.
That higher world is seven crores beyond and belongs to the supreme lord.
inference: Devotional practice leads to Vishnu's realm, which is still below the world of the supreme lord Rudra.
plain_english: Devotees of Vishnu reach his abode through meditation, worship, and recitation; seven crores beyond the world of Vishnu is the world of the supreme lord.
